QUOTE: With assembly it is `asm volatile("" : [x] "+r" (x))`. Without it, it is `x ^ mbedtls_ct_zero`... This stops the compiler from folding a known constant into a branch.
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer shows the empty asm volatile string with the value as an in-out "+r" operand, and says it exists to hide the value from the optimiser (opacity/barrier role).
